goal: Add a Playwright spec that locks the execute->poll->download contract of the weighting and eligibility mock-server routes so a future backend swap (Databricks<->ACA) cannot silently change the response shape without a test failing.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: New spec e2e/backend-contract-lock.spec.ts passes in the smoke project
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: MOCK_SERVER_PORT=8000 npm run test:e2e:fast (with mock:fast + dev:e2e running) -- all tests in backend-contract-lock.spec.ts pass

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No regressions in unit tests, lint, typecheck
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b all exit 0

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The spec fails legibly if the state/field shape changes (e.g. a field is renamed in the mock)
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: manually comment out / rename a field in mock-server/routes/weighting.js or eligibility.js, re-run the spec, confirm it fails with a clear assertion error, then revert

tasks.desc: Write e2e/backend-contract-lock.spec.ts exercising execute->poll->download for weighting via direct page.request calls against mock-server (no UI), asserting shape at each status (pending/running/completed) and CSV download
Extend the same spec with the equivalent eligibility cycle (pending->running->results_ready) and file download, asserting shape at each step
Run the spec against smoke project + full VERIFY_CMD, confirm green
Manually verify AC3: rename a field in the mock, confirm spec fails, revert
